query: For the paper "Predicting the Role of Political Trolls in Social Media" (arXiv: 1910.02001), answer this question: How large is the dataset?

drafts: The main dataset contains 2,973,371 tweets by 2848 Twitter users linked to the Russian Internet Research Agency (IRA) [16]. The data was collected and published by Linvill and Warren (2018), covering the period from February 2012 to May 2018 [5].

The main dataset contains 2,973,371 tweets by 2848 Twitter users, which the US House Intelligence Committee has linked to the Russian Internet Research Agency (IRA) [16]. The data was collected and published by Linvill and Warren (2018) and made available online, with a time span covering the period from February 2012 to May 2018 [5].
